title: The Tipping Point
author: Malcolm Gladwell
summary: Malcolm Gladwell argues that ideas, products and behaviours spread like epidemics, driven by a few people and small changes. He illustrates the idea with stories such as falling crime rates and a shoe revival.
readIf: you like readable, story-driven ideas about how trends take hold.
skipIf: you want rigorous evidence and are wary of broad claims drawn from anecdotes.
